title: ArcticBase Workbenches
description: Read-only allowlisted workbench and object metadata: no content, response payloads or custom fields. Titles, filenames and descriptions may themselves be sensitive. Only show them to intended viewers. Requires the included Python metadata collector and a compatible ArcticBase server. Only allowlisted workbench metadata is exposed. Setup: see this package's INSTALL.md in the public source release. Add an approved public source URL before submitting. Configure actual service URLs and credentials locally after import; never upload them to Workshop.
changelog: Initial public release; portable example URLs and documented local setup.
